evidence: The repo has no ESLint config or jest plugin; focused/skipped tests are blocked by Biome's noFocusedTests/noSkippedTests in biome.jsonc, so the named ESLint rules don't exist here.
Formatting is done by Biome (root `format` script and lint-staged run `biome format`), with biome.jsonc only mimicking the old Prettier settings.
.husky/pre-commit runs `pnpm pre-commit` = lint-staged, which only runs biome format/lint and git add; no type check runs.
The tree has docs/layouts/_partials/layouts/icons.html and no docs/layouts/_partials/icons.html.
core/CMakeLists.txt sets the library/runtime/archive output to target/classes/io/questdb/bin-local/ (secondary copy to questdb/bin-local/), not src/main/resources/io/questdb/bin/.
No examples/ directory exists at HEAD, only the root file examples.manifest.yaml.
Root package.json has `valelint` and `vale:fix` but no `vale` script and no vale package, so `pnpm vale` fails.
packages/mui-material/src/Button/ contains Button.js (plus Button.d.ts); there is no Button.tsx.
Button's exports are in index.js and index.d.ts; there is no index.ts.
vitest.shared.mts defaults browser instances to `process.env.VITEST_BROWSERS || 'chromium'`, so test:browser runs Chromium only unless the variable is set.
`prettier` is `pretty-quick --branch master` with no --staged flag, so it formats every file changed against master, not just staged changes.
test:unit is plain `vitest`, and with TEST_SCOPE unset vitest.config.mts runs both the browser (Playwright) and node/jsdom projects.

voucher.py line 85 is in the increase_voucher_usage function, whose body has the `F("used") + 1` increment at line 101; the file and pattern are right and the line number points into the right function.
Root package.json has no test:core:zod script.
packages/core/package.json has no typecheck:zod-compat script.
The folder is packages/playground-ui/src/domains (the same file names it correctly elsewhere); src/domain does not exist.
dev:playground:full installs, runs setup and starts examples/agent dev:ui; it's dev:playground that starts the playground, playground-ui and react client dev servers.
